summary.en-US: Mass-block X (Twitter) accounts from followers, following, likes, reposts, replies, search results or imported lists. Review before blocking, rate-limited to keep your account safe, and fully private.

description.en-US:
X Blocker helps you clean up X (Twitter) by blocking many accounts at once, safely.

**How it works**

- Open a followers, following, likes, reposts, replies, search, list or community page on x.com and open the X Blocker panel at the bottom. It works only with the accounts of that list.
- Click Review, untick anyone you want to keep, and confirm. Accounts are blocked one by one in the background.
- Each account and post also gets its own Block button, placed next to X's Follow button.
- Press Collect to save a list to your Collected list (it stops when you leave the page). It is saved only in your browser, on your device. Gather accounts from several pages, then review and block them all from the panel, or import @handles, profile links or IDs (text or CSV) in the dashboard.

**Safety**

- A daily safety limit (450 per 24 hours by default) and human-like pacing keep you under X's limits. Rate limits pause the queue, and it resumes automatically.
- Never blocks you, people you follow or people who follow you (configurable), and supports a never-block list.
- Protects against look-alike display names and @mentions, so only the intended account is blocked.

**Privacy**

- Everything stays on your own device, in your browser's own storage. There is no analytics, no server, no account and no tracking.
- Private pages (messages, notifications, settings) are never read.
- Pressing Collect only saves those accounts in the extension's own storage on your device. Nothing is uploaded, sent or shared anywhere. It happens only when you press it, and friends or people you merely read about are never saved.
- Collected profiles are forgotten after 30 days, and Delete all data wipes them in one click.

Open source (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/bitcooker/x-blocker

X Blocker is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by X Corp.

version.approval_notes:
Thank you for reviewing.

SOURCE: The submitted files are the source. There is no minification, bundling or transpiling. scripts/build.mjs only copies extension/ to dist/firefox. Repository: https://github.com/bitcooker/x-blocker

REMOTE CODE: The extension never executes remote code in its own (privileged) context. To call X's web API exactly like x.com does, content/main-world.js runs in x.com's page (MAIN world) and dynamically imports x.com's own first-party request-signing module, which is the same file x.com's client loads. X requires that module to produce the x-client-transaction-id header. The URL is discovered from scripts the page already loaded and is validated against ^https://abs.twimg.com/x-web/.../sign.*.js$ before import (see signer() in content/main-world.js). The module runs with the page's own privileges only.

NETWORK / DATA: Requests go only to x.com / api.x.com, using the user's own session. webRequest.filterResponseData passively reads X's GraphQL responses to list accounts. Private operations (DMs, chat, notifications, account, settings, payments) are skipped (PRIVATE_OPS in background.js). Nothing is transmitted to any other server. All data is stored in storage.local. data_collection_permissions: none.

TESTING: Requires an X account. Log in to x.com and open https://x.com/<any user>/followers. Block buttons appear next to Follow, and a panel at the bottom offers Review. The dashboard is the options page.
